title: Add PolyTracer to data/tools
body:
Adds `data/tools/polytracer.yaml`. Data file only — `README.md` is untouched, and `metrics`, `github` and `last_post` are left out so the refresh bot owns them.

PolyTracer is a Polymarket wallet analyzer: every wallet is replayed fill by fill from raw Polygon chain data, so win rate, ROI and P&L are recomputed rather than read off the site. Leaderboards are ranked by a 0-100 Copy Score, with win rates broken down per category, plus a live whale feed.

Against your gate for dashboards and market data: it loads, it shows live data, and nothing is behind a signup — wallets, leaderboards and category win rates are all browsable without an account, which is why `access` is omitted rather than set to `freemium`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
